title: LIT, refined entry: limit at the 1m order block after the 1m CISD (10 bars), sweep-extreme stop
question: Owner order 2026-10-18: upsizing and fewer wide stops - do tighter stops or more contracts pay on LIT?
verdict: Shorter stops by ~3 pts only; misses the winners that never come back: H1 -$15k vs live. 2026 H1 (pick) n=63 2.46/wk win 14.3% PF 2.53 net +17,462 ($2,865/mo) DD -2,900 median stop 41.0 pts, 4.0 micros, $332 at risk; eval 2wk 21.1/6.2 1mo 33.6/24.2 pass rate 56.3% median 11.5; 2026 H2 (check) n=34 2.18/wk win 23.5% PF 2.7 net +10,444 ($2,812/mo) DD -2,617 median stop 42.25 pts, 4.0 micros, $338 at risk; eval 2wk 23.1/3.8 1mo 34.6/16.7 pass rate 36.0% median 7.0; 2021-25 reference only n=433 2.02/wk win 13.9% PF 0.79 net -24,273 ($-475/mo) DD -31,585 median stop 30.0 pts, 8.0 micros, $480 at risk; eval 2wk 8.5/16.7 1mo 14.1/45.7 pass rate 19.0% median 12.0
notes: tools/lit_tightstop.py (wraps engine/lit.py; stop_mode ext + LIT size == run lit_live trade for trade). Same LIT signals and fills; the stop, entry limit or size changes. MFFU $1,000 soft daily loss modelled; NQ minis at $4.50 a round trip.
